description: INTERNAL Academic Need Score (0-100) for Greek chapters. Higher = greater academic-support need. NEVER exposed to students; NEVER a public GPA ranking. Not a sales-propensity signal (see spec §13). Weights are renormalized across whichever components have data, so a chapter with only GPA-vs-council data is still scored without fabricating the missing pieces.

gpa_vs_council.description: Chapter GPA relative to its council average. Below-average = higher need. Anchors: 0.40 BELOW council → need 100; 0.40 ABOVE → need 0.

council_percentile.description: Rank within council for the latest term. Bottom of council = higher need. need = 100 - percentile.

trend.description: Multi-term GPA trajectory. Declining = higher need.

gpa_vs_campus_baseline.description: Chapter GPA relative to the relevant campus baseline (all-men / all-women / all-undergraduate). Below baseline = higher need. Anchors: 0.40 BELOW → need 100; 0.40 ABOVE → need 0.

notes: Cross-council comparisons must use normalized measures (difference from council average / percentile), never raw GPA across councils (spec §10, §21).
